alerts.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 13 at 1:06PM EST until November 13 at 7:00PM EST by NWS Boston/Norton MA
alerts.description: * WHAT...North winds 5 to 15 kt with gusts up to 25 kt and waves around 3 feet. * WHERE...In Massachusetts coastal waters, Boston Harbor. In Rhode Island coastal waters, Narragansett Bay. * WHEN...Until 7 PM EST this evening. * IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
alerts.instruction: Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.

alerts.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 13 at 1:06PM EST until November 13 at 7:00PM EST by NWS Boston/Norton MA
alerts.areas: Cape Cod Bay; Vineyard Sound; Buzzards Bay
alerts.description: * WHAT...North winds 10 to 20 kt with gusts up to 25 kt and seas 3 to 5 feet. * WHERE...Cape Cod Bay, Vineyard Sound and Buzzards Bay. * WHEN...Until 7 PM EST this evening. * IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
alerts.instruction: Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
